recommendations.reappointment: Legal former governors can re-enter; CITY_LOST is not a political ban. No explicit merit or former-office bonus. Civil eligibility ages18–75; military retirement65–75 and ordinary initial military age gate sharply limit transfer.

weightsProposalOnly.combination: Future experiment: use maximum, not compounded products. Preserve living population, office vacancy, ban, age and military gates. Not implemented.

recommendations.politics: Current military usurper needs real office, >=2 units, >=60 months service, strength>=2, capture, different established house, ambition>loyalty. A civil title provides no army. Future independent version may add sourced city control, governance merit, family and real military supporters to crisis competition after existing opportunity; no current probability changes.

limitations: The user original 594-year save is unavailable; reported seed is a fresh scenario run, not an exact replay of that save.
Long runs reuse seed prefixes; checkpoint totals are not independent samples.
Final timers ran serially after our parallel jobs ended; unrelated user applications were left running.
Core manual fixed-step timing is separate from offscreen Electron live4x and human UI acceptance.
Annual snapshots establish necessary territory and alive-state blockers, not every monthly stability/city/24-month hold gate.
Population has no authoritative ethnicity attribute; name culture counts cannot establish ethnic population percentages.
No long-lived trusted simulation caches or authority/schema changes. V59 retained; older schemas remain rejected.
